agyos_skill.instructions: Use the source toolkit when it is available. This skill contains planning guidance and a manifest scaffolder; it does not itself render video. The supplied renderer is JavaScript/Canvas in headless Chrome plus FFmpeg. It is not Remotion. 1. Check `tools/video/faceless-shorts` first, then the user-provided location, current project, and skill folder for scripts/new_video.sh and styles/. Confirm the root also has scripts/voice.py and scripts/words.py. Set KIT_ROOT to that root. If absent, offer a script/shot plan; do not claim to have rendered a video or invent toolkit paths. 2. Reuse details already provided. Ask together only for missing choices that change the result: topic or source script, duration, style, voice, recorded narration versus local TTS, captions, and music. Defaults from the source skill are about 30 seconds, am_michael, local TTS, and the existing style example. Confirm before installing packages, creating a model environment, downloading model weights, or using a paid service. 3. For factual subjects, gather reliable sources and attach them to the script's sources field. Keep health, safety, crime, and historical claims proportionate to evidence. If a fact cannot be verified, omit it or label the uncertainty. Never invent quotes, statistics, or evidence. Show a compact plan with narration, source list, line/cut timing, selected style, shot descriptions, caption treatment, music, and any assumptions. Wait for approval before building unless the user's current or prior instruction already authorized the build. Ask only for missing information that changes the result. Keep narration natural and continuous. The toolkit suggests roughly 90–110 words for 35 seconds, but the generated audio duration is authoritative. A seamless loop is optional and must not distort the ending. Choose among the six styles in [the style reference](references/ANIMATION_STYLES_MANUAL.md).
